Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Tiered onboarding credits and invoicing question

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the rundown of Redwood's accelerator benefits on Friday. Two quick follow-ups from our side as we prep the cohort budget: do you have flexibility to (a) stagger free credits over the first three months instead of a single upfront bucket, and (b) apply any unused portion as a credit against the first paid invoice if we convert to a paid plan within 90 days?

Orbit Labs is planning to onboard 6 teams in August; our finance lead (cc'd) is worried about a single large credit line showing as a contra-revenue item on our books. If a staircase/deferral approach is possible, that would help us sign off faster.

Appreciate any examples or standard language you use for accelerator cohorts (MOUs, invoice timing, expiration).

Thanks,
Emma Clarke
Program Manager, Orbit Labs
[Attachment: cohort_overview.csv (text/csv)]
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Emma Clarke <emma@orbitlabs.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tiered onboarding credits and invoicing question

Emma —

Appreciate the specifics — great to hear about 6 teams. Short answers: yes, we can do a staggered ("staircase") credit schedule and we can apply unused credits to the first invoice under a conversion within a defined window, with a couple of guardrails from finance.

Draft proposal (high level):
- Tranche A: 25k credits on day 0 (for setup/initial experiments)
- Tranche B: 25k credits at 30 days if at least one team has hit 2k monthly active tokens (simple usage check)
- Tranche C: 25k credits at 60 days conditional on engagement (meet with Redwood solutions)
- Unused credits from Tranche A/B/C can be applied as an invoice credit against the first paid invoice if conversion occurs within 90 days of the tranche issuance.

Constraints and asks from our side:
- Credits tied to the HubSpot deal id (ORBIT-2026-07) so finance can track consumption and revenue recognition.
- We will need a signed MOU that contains the tranche schedule and conversion rules. I attached a one-page MOU template for your review.

If this looks reasonable I can loop in Finance formally for signoff (cc'd: Monica) and have Lauren coordinate onboarding timing and the initial usage milestones.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Team —

Forwarding Emma's request and my proposed staircase. Quick asks from ops/partnership perspective:
- Lauren: can you own the onboarding milestones and define the "engagement" metric for Tranche C? Keep it simple (one solutions call + workspace created + sample prompt run).
- Ben: this falls into the accelerator sweetener bucket — any objection to the tranche sizes above? We typically do 50–75k for cohorts of this size but spacing it out reduces risk.
- Monica: need your read on the accounting/tax side; specifically whether finance is comfortable treating the tranches as prepaid credits with a 90-day conversion credit policy. If not, what's the maximum deferral window you can approve?

Also attaching a sample invoice template that finance asked for earlier. If we need to convert tranches to a discount on invoice, we'll need the legal entity and billing contact from Orbit.

Thanks — please reply inline so I can consolidate and send a single MOU back to Emma.

--
Karthik

From: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fw: Tiered onboarding credits and invoicing question

Karthik / team —

Finance POV: we can support a staggered credit schedule with these explicit controls:
- Max deferral window: 60 days from tranche issuance (Finance records prefer shorter). We can extend to 90 days for Strategic partners with CFO approval.
- All tranches must be tied to the HubSpot deal id ORBIT-2026-07 and consumption must be billed to that record for reconciliation.
- Credits used as invoice offsets will appear as a contra line on the first invoice and require a signed MOU that references the offset rule.
- We need the legal entity name, billing address, and tax ID before we can issue the first tranche.

Redlines to Karthik's proposed wording: change the 90-day conversion window to 60 days unless they request a CFO exception. Also add a consumption threshold for Tranche B: at least 1k active tokens across the cohort (we want to avoid tranche issuance for purely test projects).

If Orbit can provide entity details and sign the MOU by EOD Friday, Finance can approve the staggered treatment and Monica can sign off on the CFO exception pathway.

—Monica Patel
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
